tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: The mascot's chocolate, in both themes: the block and the gaps between its squares.

tokens.name: bar-top
tokens.usage: The tops of the mascot's chocolate squares, a step lighter than `bar`, in both themes.

tokens.name: mascot-blush
tokens.usage: The mascot's cheeks on its salmon wrapper, at 35% opacity, in both themes.

tokens.name: line-art
tokens.usage: The outline of every illustration in both themes: the mascot, the box's contents and the marshmallows, a warm mid-brown that keeps the drawings soft. Eyes, the mascot's chocolate edge and other small darks stay `cocoa`.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background: milk by day, dark chocolate at night.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Sheets and cards that sit on `ground`.

tokens.name: box
tokens.usage: The inside of the chocolate box: the tray the pralines sit in, and the paper of a cup.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers and a cup's pleats. Decorative only; a control's edge uses `line-strong`.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that carry meaning: secondary buttons, inputs (at least 3.0:1 on `ground`, `surface` and `box` by day, 3.6:1 at night).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings and the wordmark on `ground`, `surface` and `box` (at least 12.3:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Long running text, such as an article's paragraphs: `ink` by day, a step softer than `ink` at night so a long read doesn't glare (12.9:1 on `ground`).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `ground`, `surface` and `box`: captions, dates, the line under a title (at least 5.6:1 by day, 7.7:1 at night).

tokens.name: chocolate
tokens.usage: The primary action's fill, once per view: milk chocolate by day, white chocolate at night.

tokens.name: on-chocolate
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `chocolate` (13.7:1 by day, 11.2:1 at night).

tokens.name: on-flavour
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any flavour fill, in both themes (at least 9.8:1).

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: The whipped cream on the hot cocoa: white by day, a warm off-white at night so it doesn't glare on the dark page.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring around any control, offset 2px (at least 5.6:1 on `ground`, `surface` and `box` by day, 11.7:1 at night).

families.display: Gluten, "Arial Rounded MT Bold", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hello at the top of the page. Once per page.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Titles inside a feature, such as a project's name. Gluten is never set smaller than 32px.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Software engineer who loves UI design and illustration, and breaking into things.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A praline's or a card's name.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Night Shift, made yours: a small Mac app that keeps it off where you need true colour.
styles.usage: Running text, at most 65 characters a line.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Free and open source, for macOS 15 or later.
styles.usage: Captions, dates and the line under a praline's name.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and section labels, set in capitals.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: A handwritten aside beside the thing it points at, with the curly arrow. Four per page at most.

styles.name: note-s
styles.usage: A small aside on phones, and the tiny sign-off at the very bottom of the page.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a doodle and its label; between a praline's name and its line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row; inside chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a title and its text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The side gutter on phones; the gap between pralines; padding inside a praline.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The box's padding; padding inside cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between cards that aren't in a box.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: The side gutter on wide screens; between a headline and what it introduces.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Between sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Between sections on wide screens: the white space that tells the story.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips and small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Pralines and their cups.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The box and big panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and sprinkles.

tokens.name: column
tokens.usage: The content column, the same as Nightcap's site. Text, the box and section content sit in it; section backgrounds run full-bleed.

tokens.name: shadow-sit
tokens.usage: Anything sitting in the box: a praline at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A praline picked up on hover or focus. Nothing else casts a shadow.

tokens.name: ease-pop
tokens.usage: Pops and lifts: an overshoot that settles, like soft candy.

tokens.name: ease-soft
tokens.usage: Peels, fades and drifts: fast out, slow in, no overshoot.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Presses and colour changes.

tokens.name: dur-pop
tokens.usage: A praline lifting, a button springing, a praline dropping into its cup.

tokens.name: dur-peel
tokens.usage: A foil peeling back, and folding again.

tokens.name: dur-drift
tokens.usage: One sprinkle's slow fall through the page; doodles sway on a third of it.
